title: Resvelons nous resvelons amoureux / Alons en bien tos au may (Du Fay)
desc: Guillaume Du Fay, Resvelons nous resvelons amoureux / Alons en bien tos au may. 3 voices (Cantus, Contratenor, Tenor), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Duf3069); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
